symptom: The PR validators record errors through mutable Array.prototype.push. In a synthetic no-op push runtime, invalid required fields leave error arrays empty and can be admitted. No live research data corruption was observed.
lesson: Replacing iterator and forEach-dependent admission checks does not protect validators if their error sinks still delegate to mutable Array.prototype.push; a suppressed error array can produce a false valid result.
guardrail: Record validation failures by indexed assignment, not mutable Array.prototype.push. Verify both valid-record parity and invalid-record rejection under a synthetic no-op push with the actual repository TypeScript runner before integration.
